description: Where the development of an OrchesTwin project stands, with buttons that write the ut commands in the terminal of the editor.
container.title: OrchesTwin
view.name: Project
command.status: Show where the project stands (ut status)
command.test: Verify the acceptance criteria (ut test, may spend)
command.verify: Review the commits with the twins (ut verify, may spend)
command.recheck: Review again the commits of an earlier design (ut verify --recheck, may spend)
command.align: Align the knowledge to the code (ut align, may spend)
command.code: Start the coding agent on the open tasks (ut code, on your own account)
command.tasks: List the tasks for the code (ut tasks)
command.twinsUpdate: Let the twins learn from the development (ut twins update, may spend)
command.openReport: Open the report of the latest test run
command.connectAgents: Connect the twins to the agents of the editor
command.why: Why? Read the artifact chain from the local Dossier (ut why --offline)
command.validation: Read hypotheses and outcomes from the verified local Dossier (ut validation --offline)
command.scenarioWalkthrough: Read a scenario walkthrough from the verified local Dossier (ut validation walkthrough --offline)

configuration.utCommand: The program used by the panel: ut, or its full path. Why? reads offline; validation offers explicit local or Studio reads; development commands run in the terminal.
